The Traditional Approach Destroys Teeth

Most dentists drill aggressively, place crowns that leak, and perform root canals that lead to tooth failure.

All Crowns Eventually Leak

Traditional crowns create hiding places for bacteria. Once bacteria gets underneath, it's impossible to clean, leading to decay and eventual tooth failure.

The Cycle of Destruction

Filling → bigger filling → crown → crown replacement → root canal → extraction. Each step weakens your tooth further until it's lost forever.

Why It Persists

Traditional dentistry is faster and more profitable. Crowns can be placed quickly, but they don't preserve your natural tooth structure like biomimetic approaches.

A Better Way

Biomimetic Dentistry Preserves Your Natural Teeth

Dr. Noot layers composite resins and crafts custom inlays, onlays, and veneers for a crown-free, seamless fit that preserves your natural tooth strength.

No painful needles — Advanced techniques eliminate discomfort
No grinding drills — Preserve maximum tooth structure
Crown-free restorations — Seamless integration with your natural teeth

Keep Your Natural Teeth for Life

1

Schedule a Consultation

Keep Your Natural Teeth for Life
